page_title: ATA 1-1 PIS | Atalanta v Pisa 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90+1' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' A quickly taken corner by Pisa.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch so that Giorgio Scalvini can be given a rest.

88' A lofted cross from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is behind the touchline and Atalanta will take a throw-in.
86' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
84' Ivan Juric isn't happy on the touchline after referee Alberto Arena shows him a yellow card.
84' Substitution. Charles De Ketelaere is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
83' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alberto Arena didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
83' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alberto Arena signals.
83' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
81' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) meets a cross inside the box, but Adrian Semper wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
81' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
80' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
78' Daniel Denoon (Pisa) is being substituted because of an injury. Alberto Gilardino sends Arturo Calabresi on the pitch.
78' Substitution. Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) has come on for Marius Marin.
77' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
75' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

74' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
74' Wonderful movement by Atalanta. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is replacing Gianluca Scamacca.
71' Here is a change. Daniel Maldini is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
71' Mario Pasalic comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ederson (Atalanta).
70' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

70' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) unleashes a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Adrian Semper thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner.
68' Wonderful movement by Pisa. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
66' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) meets a cross inside the box, but Adrian Semper wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
64' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

63' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Adrian Semper produces a wonderful reflex save. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
62' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) replaces Stefano Moreo.
61' Substitution. Matteo Tramoni did his best and is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa).

60' Samuele Angori (Pisa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
60' Pisa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

57' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa. Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly over the crossbar.

56' Adrian Semper was forced into action to thwart Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Henrik Meister departs the field of play to be replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Pisa).
54' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
50' 1 - 1 Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
50' Henrik Meister (Pisa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
49' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
48' Atalanta are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.

46' Atalanta slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) brings his opponent down. Alberto Arena has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Samuele Angori (Pisa) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
42' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
41' The resulting corner from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
40' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
40' None of the Pisa players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.

39' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Marco Carnesecchi, who pulls off a stunning save! Pisa will take a corner kick.

37' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
35' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

32' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Atalanta are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
30' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

30' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
28' Alberto Arena shows a yellow card to Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
26' 0 - 1 This is definitely not what Isak Hien (Atalanta) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 0:1.
25' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
25' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) will take a corner kick.
25' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Atalanta earn a corner.
22' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. It's a throw-in for Pisa.
20' Pisa showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will take a throw-in.
17' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

17' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atalanta.

16' A rebound sits up nicely for Michel Aebischer (Pisa) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the left post and out for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
15' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

14' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.

12' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Marco Carnesecchi is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
11' The free kick is delivered by Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
10' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
10' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
8' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' A long ball forward to Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) is intercepted.
4' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
3' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
2' The ball is cleared after Samuele Angori (Pisa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
1' Atalanta show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Alberto Arena is introduced as the referee for today's match.
